newsitem.title: THAILAND: Securities One to sell shares to Amsteel.
newsitem.headline: Securities One to sell shares to Amsteel.

text.p: Thailand's Securities One Plc confirmed on Wednesday that it would sell 49.95 million shares of First Asia Securities Plc worth 1.02 billion baht ($40.08 million) to Malaysia's Amsteel Capital Holdings Bhd.
The deal for the sale was concluded in April.

Securities One said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that an approval to sell 49.95 million shares, equivalent to 99.89 percent out of its total shares, of First Asia Securities to Amsteel Capital was made by the company board on Tuesday.
Malaysian-based Amsteel Capital Holdings is a member of the Amsteel Securities Group, which is in turn owned by Amsteel Corp Bhd
The Thai bourse in February suspended shares of First Asia Securities after the company had informed the bourse that it had agreed to sell 90 million baht of fixed assets to Securities One.
